rejected_findings.title: Wordmark test asserts substring href="/" which any landing link satisfies
rejected_findings.reason: False positive: in the demo view (shell + dashboard + demo banner) the ONLY href="/" is the wordmark itself (shell.gleam:83); auth_layout's href="/" is not rendered on routes.Demo. The test currently bites — if the wordmark regressed to /dashboard, contains("href=\"/\"") would fail.

findings.title: demo_store.remind_applicant returns #(0,1) 'follow-up sent' for an email not in the pool (nothing mutates); documented #(0,0) branch is unreachable
findings.detail: sent_reminded is False both for already-reminded rows AND unknown emails; the latter yields a phantom follow-up toast. Latent from the UI (buttons only render for pool rows), but contradicts the documented remind_applicant_toast_copy 1,0/0,1/0,0 semantics and double-scans rows (contains + find).
findings.recommended_fix: Single list.find: Ok(a) -> #(!a.reminded mapped to #(1,0)/#(0,1)); Error -> #(store, #(0,0)) so unknown emails report nothing sent.

findings.title: Fix-6 AC is 'zero `grace` grep hits in demo code' but 4 comment/docstring hits remain
findings.detail: grep -rni grace over client/src/demo, client/test/demo, server/src/demo returns 4 hits, all in comments. Functional purge is complete (a-grainne PDF baked, no live ids), but the literal acceptance criterion fails.
findings.recommended_fix: Reword the comments to avoid the old id (e.g. '// Purged legacy id -> a-grainne.'), or relax the AC wording explicitly.

findings.title: Fix 4 (report-detail enrichment) has zero automated coverage — pdf_prebake extras_for/income_sources_for/documents_for untested
findings.detail: grep -rln pdf_prebake server/test/ returns nothing; the only report test pins the id->filename mapping. The per-applicant verification_summary/income/documents baked into the 8 PDFs can silently regress. Fixture truth is also triplicated between pdf_prebake and client demo_store with no pin test (architecture lens).
findings.recommended_fix: Add a server unit test asserting the enriched payload per applicant id (via to_report_data), plus a check that all 8 report-a-*.pdf assets exist.

findings.title: awaiting/2 doc comment claims a seed fallback; the code returns [] on a missing key
findings.detail: Comment promises 'fallback to the seed when the key is absent'; awaiting_for returns []. Behaviour is fine (seed() always populates), only the comment misleads.
findings.recommended_fix: Reword the docstring to 'unknown vacancy yields an empty pool'.

findings.title: Test helper result_map_custom re-implements gleam/result.map
findings.detail: Hand-rolled duplicate of result.map in the test file; DRY drift risk.
findings.recommended_fix: Import gleam/result and call result.map at the use sites; delete the helper.

findings.title: Demo reminder mutations leave vacancy-detail header counts stale until next detail load
findings.detail: Confirmed: after remind, only the awaiting list is refetched; vacancy_detail (which holds awaiting_count/remindable_count/followup_count derived in demo_store.gleam:875-877) is not refreshed. However the REAL flow shares the identical handler shape — the staleness is parity, not a demo regression.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: also refetch vacancy detail after a successful reminder (both modes), or pin the stale-until-reload behaviour in a test.

findings.title: a-grace purge pin asserts presence of a-grainne but never absence of a-grace, despite its doc comment
findings.detail: Verified: the body only asserts detail.application.id == "a-grainne" and list membership; a lingering a-grace key in movement_for/audit_for would not fail the test.
findings.recommended_fix: Add negative assertions: application_detail(store, "v-maples", "a-grace") is Error; report_filenames() has no a-grace key.

findings.title: remind_applicant pins only the #(1,0) stage — follow-up #(0,1) and unknown-email paths untested
findings.detail: Verified: the only pin dispatches emma.doyle (un-reminded). The followed_up flip and the phantom #(0,1) branch are unexercised.
findings.recommended_fix: Add pins for peter.lyons (follow-up, followed_up True) and an unknown email asserting #(0,0) once W1 is fixed.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: PASS
findings.detail: P0 100%: no-network lint + 8 bite-tests intact and re-run green this round; client suite 626/626 green locally. P1 >=90%: fixes 2,5,6 pinned; fixes 1,3 verified-parity pins exist. Fix-4 coverage gap is the one open item.
findings.recommended_fix: Close the fix-4 coverage gap in a follow-up.
